lines: Now I'll write the ADR for the tech stack selection.
Now update the README, project memory, and move the task file.
> $ git add projects/ai-office-brand/ && git commit -m "agent(bjorn): tech stack sel

Done. Here's a summary of what was decided and delivered:

**ADR: `projects/ai-office-brand/output/2026-03-30-tech-stack-adr.md`**

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|----------|--------|-----|
| Framework | **Astro** | Purpose-built for static marketing sites — zero JS shipped by default, islands for any interactive bits |
| CSS | **Tailwind CSS v3** | Fast iteration, built-in design system, maps directly to brand tokens from Jorunn's work |
| Hosting | **Vercel** | Zero-config GitHub deploys, preview URLs on PRs, edge CDN |
| Animations | **Motion One** | ~3kb, framework-agnostic, designed exactly for scroll-triggered entrance effects |

The ADR includes options considered, tradeoffs, final choices, and a recommended folder structure for Arve to follow during implementation. Task moved to `completed/`, project memory updated, committed and pushed.
